training_configs.qwen2vl_lora_c3_v2.yaml:
### C3 v2 — QLoRA on Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, trained from the base model (no adapter chaining)
### model
model_name_or_path: D:\university\Resesarch\RD\models\Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct
image_max_pixels: 262144          # must equal inference resolution (local_vision_oracle.dataset_v2.TRAINING_MAX_PIXELS)
quantization_bit: 4               # QLoRA: base weights NF4, LoRA weights fp16 -> fits 4 GB VRAM
trust_remote_code: true

### method
stage: sft
do_train: true
finetuning_type: lora
lora_rank: 16
lora_alpha: 32
lora_dropout: 0.05
lora_target: all                  # all linear layers of the language model; vision tower frozen
freeze_vision_tower: true

### dataset
dataset_dir: D:\university\Resesarch\RD\LLaMA-Factory\data
dataset: c3v2_train               # compact 3-field target, invisible mutations removed
template: qwen2_vl
cutoff_len: 1024
preprocessing_num_workers: 1
dataloader_num_workers: 0
seed: 42

### output
output_dir: D:\university\Resesarch\results\c3_lora_v2
logging_steps: 10
save_strategy: epoch              # one checkpoint per epoch, chosen later by validation accuracy
plot_loss: true
overwrite_output_dir: true
save_only_model: true
report_to: none

### train
per_device_train_batch_size: 1
gradient_accumulation_steps: 8    # effective batch 8
learning_rate: 1.0e-4
num_train_epochs: 3.0
lr_scheduler_type: cosine
warmup_steps: 26                  # ~5% of 3 x 173 steps (transformers 5 has no warmup_ratio)
fp16: true
